text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing... Aston Machan. I mean,
she was
pretty great in her debut.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, plus... She's just so darn cute when
she runs!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's adorable! The way her legs thump,
thump,
thump as she zooms by!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And when you see someone put their
entire heart
into something, doesn't it
just make you want to
cheer for them?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Was that Aston Machan just
now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Guess what, Trainer. Apparently, the way I run is quite lovely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure exactly what happened to
prompt
this, but I'm guessing someone
gave her a
compliment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I don't know if "lovely" is how I'd
describe
it, that unique short stride of
hers is without a
doubt her biggest
advantage on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wherever they're coming from, if
compliments
boost her confidence, then
they're the best thing
for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn towards Aston Machan... only to
find that
she's almost out of sight
already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's heading casually toward the
paddock
without so much as a glance
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurry into the stands so as not to miss a
thing.
